title: ChronoLink: Anchor & Echo
tagline: One of you is in 1924, the other in the same building's 2026 ruins. Whatever the Anchor leaves somewhere spends a century there: dry planks become bridges, wet ones rot, acorns become trees, running water floods and erodes. 14 hand-built chambers.

roles.name: The Anchor (1924)
roles.description: WASD and E. Carries planks and acorns, shoves crates, turns sluice wheels. Everything left behind ages into 2026.

roles.name: The Echo (2026)
roles.description: Arrows and Enter (F or . to pin). Walks the result, holds whatever it stands on still, pins tiles, kicks rusted bars and empties the Stash Box.

multiplayer.style: asymmetric co-op, split screen or two tabs
multiplayer.notes: Split screen on one keyboard by default. A second tab links automatically over BroadcastChannel('chronolink-sync'); the Online button links two devices through the hub relay with a 4-letter code.
